text: Mauhaus Cafe is part of the trend of new cat cafes appearing in the US.  US laws are a bit more strict, so they aren't as crazy as the ones in Asia.  The baked goods here are very tasty.  The cats were friendly and did not seem to be tortured by living in a cafe.  It was kind of smelly in the car area, but what do you expect.

I LOVE this place! Theodore our server was the epitome of great service! We followed each and every one of his recommendations from start to finish and I am so glad we did because EVERYTHING was delicious! The calamari, Fettuccine Imperial, and Three-Cheese Tortellini, and Tomato Bisque were all great picks. My favorite of the entire meal though was the Pecan Butter Crunch Cake. Y'all I was hesitant at first, but Theodore assured me it's one of his favorites and now I understand why. I'm tempted to go back there for that desert alone. It's so freaking good!
My favorite Italian place ever! Family owned and operated, cheap, and the food is amazing.

So disappointing. We have been to Spirous in the past and it has always been delicious, not this time. Pancakes were tasteless, almost like they had too much flour in them. My husband's potatoes tasted terrible, like they were old terrible. Stars are only for the service, which was excellent. I dont know if the place has changed owners, but we won't be returning anytime soon.

I've been a Panera fan since my college days. I love the fresh food and the welcoming atmosphere that engulfs you whenever you walk in. 

Last week I was leaving my dentist appointment and Panera is close by. This particular location is special to me because I used to work nearby and would come here for lunch often during the week. I haven't worked at my old job in at least 5 years. I was surprised and happy to see when I walked into Panera a familiar face was standing behind the counter. 

If you've been to this location then you have to know Darwin. He's always smiling, eager to help and super quick on his feet to take and pack up your order. He always has a willing and helpful attitude and just brighten up anyone's day when you walk in. He's a valuable assets to the Panera team and I'll definitely keep coming back to this location due to him. 

I didn't take any food pics but if you want to know what I ordered here's some of my fave Panera items:
-chocolate croissants 
-half a dozen bagel pack (plain, Asiago cheese, cinnamon crunch)
-oatmeal cookies 
-Orange juice 

PRO TIP- join their rewards program to get points and free food perks!
Attentive service and very good food in particular the kimchi pineapple, fried chicken, we had both the wet and dry variety and finally the Dan dan noodles very tasty

Dim Sum House has some pretty solid dim sum dishes. I like how they split it into Shanghai and Cantonese Style. Soup dumplings are very flavorful. The The dumpling wrap is a bit on the thick side. Also had the dan dan noodles that they mix for you. Again good flavor. Only critique on that is a bit too much sauce and could be spicier. But everyone's spice meter is different. Egg custard bao buns are a great way to end the meal on a sweet note. Great selection of beers and wines to choose from. 

They are also very good about following COVID recommendations and keep everything very clean.
Outstanding cheesesteaks,  and hoagies! It's just that simple.  No need to explain.  If you're from philly you need nothing else,either you have it or not. This place is top of the list!

Well since I haven't had a chance to dine  at California 
burger I decided to try Freddie's and boy I'm glad I 
did everything I had was absolutely delicious right 
down to there fries there a little pricey but it was ok 
It was well worth it now I see why  Steak & shakes are
closed down (lol)

A friend and I were passing through Boise on a road trip, and looked up the coffee shop with the most reviews. Flying M did not disappoint. Not only is it great coffee, they have solid baked goods, and all of the best merchandise I've ever seen at a coffee shop. They have a gift shop full of clever and hilarious merchandise that will knock your socks off. Definitely a must-stop shop.

so, picked up some hand cut steaks to grill at home. Referred to this option during corona virus by a friend. Ordered a bone in a Rib Eye ($13), and a couple of New York cuts ($9). Listen, these were by far better than any butcher shop and after grilling had visions of rainbows and paradise. Support local! Thanks Texas Roadhouse, feeling the love.

We have ordered carry out twice and it is my family's favorite restaurant!!! It is so delicious and the staff is kind. They always have everything packaged great so nothing spills in the car. The pho has wonderful flavor and the fried rice is another family favorite. Highly recommend trying them out!

It sucks!  I can't compare the little italian in san Francisco to this place.. I was expecting more that is why I came here in the first place.im expecting more  Like areal italian food. For me there food s are more like americanize italian food in the can.  no taste at all like your in italy italys kitchen. . Its so blunt! No taste. At all. I ordered something like pasta with a "wild boar meat" damn I tasted it like a sheared steak meat in some grocery store.  I didn't feel  any boar meat at all!!! My wife ordered a veil marsala, and it taste like shit! We ask the waiter what's a marsala taste and  looks like and he  doesn't even know. I'm not impressed at all on this place,  They should do better than what they claiming  as italian food. . I will never recommend this place to any one.  I been with so much italian restaurant and this pace taste like a casino coffee shop! And I didn't know why  they getting four star? Sorry, but I can't give then A four star, I would say a 0 star! I can't believe that people fall on a four star review to come in  this place  this place SUCKS no dought about it!  Sorry! Pls do better

Typically love Syphay - its my go to! The other night, I did a pick up order, when I had arrived the associate asked me what my pick up number was. I proceeded to tell her, then she gave me the wrong order. I am full fledged vegetarian and I received beef and chicken noodles. When I called to see if I could go pick up my correct order, they told me there was nothing they could do and to contact skip the dishes. I just find it extremely frustrating that the weren't able to rectify the matter and I had to jump hurdles to be reimbursed.
Love the Avocado Toast. Took train to Santa Barbara at earlier morning. Goat Tree is the one restaurant start 7:00am. Feel perfect get hot food after walked pier.

This is my favorite Indian place especially for take out during the pandemic. They set up a very convenient and safe pickup window so you don't need to go inside the restaurant. For a bit of heat, we like their vindaloo and for something mild that kids can eat we love their veggie korma and palaks.
Great place to visit with friends and family. The menu is wide and it shows popular food from Central Asia cuisine . Meals are taste and the portions are huge. I'm always happy to come back.

The service sucked!!! The waitress hardly came over to check on us. I had to ask her 4 different times to get me some extra salad dressing. Then when it came time to pay, the cashier was rude and unfriendly. If the restaurant parking across the street wasn't full, I would've went there. The only friendly person was the sweet bus boy. We noticed also that if you were not brown, you got serviced better. I wish I had a better experience here.

The two positives here: 
- the friendly bus boy 
-the food was good 

Negative: 
Need to improve on the customer service

Hands down the best Indian food around. Nice amount of spice, great service and nice menu selection. 

Be sure to go on Thursday evening when they have a breakfast buffet. If you are curious about an India breakfast buffet for dinner you really need to try it. Amazing.   Along with the buffet come a great selection of Dosas.

Ordered food to go from there to pick up. Since we are in the middle of a pandemic, we wore masks and ordered ahead so that we didn't stay too long. Got there and noticed the bar was completely full with different parties seated right next to each other at the bar top. No masks or social distancing. The bartender (who helped us with our order) was wearing his mask around his neck, didn't wear gloves while handing ice and lemons and such, and did not wash his hands in the 20 mins we were there. The food was pretty good but if the staff at the front of the house doesn't have to wear anything to protect people, worried about what's happening in the kitchen...

Mac and cheese is good but a little bland, pulled pork sandwich was pretty good, Caesar salad didn't come with dressing.

We are still trying to support small businesses. We really wanted Chinese food. I looked up a close restaurant. Most of them where closed but I found a place about 15 minutes away. Called the Golden Dragon and it was open. The food was ok. It was not as good as our regular place. It was about a dollar more per item. I did ask if their food had MSG in it. They said no. I still got a headache. I doubt I will go back.
Hands down the BEST pizza in Tucson!!! I don't even like this crust anywhere else, but theirs is even better than their thick crust!

Mix Bakeshop bakes unreal deliciousness. They seem to make everything from scratch. the crust holds like a baby cherub before crumbling at each bite; and the rest of the pie is 95% coconut.  The coconut tastes like it has a passport from the Ceylons. I HATE COCONUT; BUT I ALREADY ATE HALF OF IT MYSELF.

Very casual place and we just grabbed food for takeout, but wow, the food is  just wonderful.  

I had the grouper sandwich and it was so flavorful!  The conch fritters were also really great.  

Everyone I was with enjoyed their meal.  Friendly staff too.  Check it out when you're in Tampa!
I am giving 5 star only because of server as she was very nice and all the time while we were there she tried to be useful.
I went to The Pythian Market to enjoy the Dirty South. The Market has a lot of choices (pop up food truck) love it. The service and food was very good.

I'm already a huge fan of Goodfellas (Lexington KY - represent!) and the Broad Ripple location is great for a late night slice before heading home in an Uber but this location has such a cool vibe. Sure, they have your typical pizza counter up front but the coolest part is the lounge-like, speakeasy feel of their bar in the back. Not to mention the bourbon selection is top-notch. As a bourbon drinker, I always appreciate a knowledgeable bartender who makes wholesome suggestions and really knows what type of bourbon you like. Paired with comfy couches and a dim-lit room, this is perfect for a low-key night!

Wanted to eat here for Brunch this past Sunday and the girls working were rude and indifferent to welcoming us. No one came to greet us, we had to go to them. There was plenty of tables open when we asked how long the wait was, they responded that we'd have to wait 45 minutes minimum for a table because they had upcoming reservations. It's interesting to turn away customers that want to dine when they are already there for people that aren't there yet and who may cancel. Was excited to try Somo for the longest time, but I'm never going back.

Hellllllla good and such good and friendly service. The soup hot at first, but don't get me wrong, it cooled down with time. Don't get me started on the Pad See Ew- so yummy! Wow, what a night! Will definitely return soon :)
The food is always good... but some of the employees are out right rude and yell at their customers. I just wish I knew the name of the young women who just yelled at me for no apparent reason.

Juniper is a delightful restaurant experience from start to finish. The restaurant itself has a great, one of a kind design which creates a nice vibe. It is a shame it can't be showed off as much now because of COVID. The cocktails are delicious and the food was amazing. I don't think you can go wrong with anything on the menu. Everything tastes fresh and homemade - like it should! 

I'f you are looking to try a new place in the CWE - go here.

P.s. Definitely try any of the items with fried chicken. Enjoy!

So so happy to report that they still have an amazing roast beef po-boy!  

The best in town though??  Perhaps, and I have no problem with that claim.   Absolutely delicious, made with care, perfect bread!  A bit salty for my liking, but within reason (and most people's tastes).

Forget about Tracey's, this timeless place is still where it's at!

Burgers are pretty great. The ginger strawberry soda is always my go to. My only complaint is that I've never had good service there. Had to wait until my food came out to catch my waitress to get the water I had asked for initially. FYI we were sitting outside in July so it was quite hot. The food is really great and comes out pretty quick but almost not worth the trouble.

What can I say except that this is my new favorite place in Tucson to eat!! The quality of the food, the service from EVERYONE, the COVID-19 measures...Perfection!! This is the first restaurant I've visited since February and it was SO worth the wait!!

If I could give no stars that's how much I would give! I was driving in from out of state. Of course I read all the signs that state they are only sitting 25% of the full capacity. I asked to be placed on the list to sit a party of 12 understanding that we would be sat in party of 4's. The host screamed at me stating that "NO I DONT HAVE SPACE HERE IM ALREADY AT CAPACITY ON THIS SIDE AND IM ALREADY FULL ON THIS SIDE, SO NO IVE ALREADY HAD A BIG PARTY. I CANT HAVE TOU HERE." Screaming so loud that everyone in the dining rooms were looking at the scene she was causing as she was yelling at me and my family as if we had demanded to be seated right away. I would have understood if she had said there would be a long waiting time or whatever the case may have been. But no, she wasn't professional and was not respectful. I would never recommend ever going to this Denny's. This women needs to be trained how to treat people and fired because she will continue to run of loyal customers. It's called respect and she has none.
Best damn Calzone ever! Flavors to die for recommend the Duke and Meat me in St Louis. Hope to see one of these in Houston soon

Took the history cruise to the Battle of New Orleans site.  Logistics were handled smoothly by the crew and we got truly excellent narration from Wendell on New Orleans history and details of the battle - a lot of solid information very engagingly presented.  Strongly recommend this cruise for anyone interested in seeing New Orleans from the river and learning about its history.

Stopped for dinner spent a day in Dunedin! Margarita was excellent!!!!!!! (Had 2) the blackened chicken and buffalo style sandwich were excellent !!!! We were debating eating at the Irish pub the living room or another bar and sooo glad we picked this restaurant!! Highly recommend for lunch or dinner    Staff was super nice too!!!

This place is fabulous. The place had a line at the door before the place opened at 4:30pm. You can put your name on a list and order your dough for your pizza and the servers will call when your table is ready. The restaurant is dine in only. It reminded me of the pizza I ate when I went to Naples. The pizza was delicious. The Nutella dessert pizza was equally delicious so save room to eat that as well. The owner's (Dave) father and mom were in the restaurant when my family was there and they made us feel like we were part of there family. His parents were so sweet and inviting. They talked to us while we waited to be seated. We will definitely visit again when we are in the area or make a special trip. You won't be disappointed in the food or the service.

My wife and I keep a list of our top ten dining experiences.  After nearly 40 years of travelling and  dining in holes in the wall to AAA five diamond restaurants, it is really hard for a new place to make that list. Once Upon A Time managed to break in quite easily.  Your first impression on walking in is pandemonium but you quickly realize that everything is completely under control.  The space is small and joyously boisterous, and you are immediate friends with the folks at the next table. We got lucky and were seated at a table just next to the little window to the kitchen.  Not only did we get to watch the incredible dishes go by, but we also got to chat with Chef Laurent. He is proud of his family operation, and just as proud to serve his father's onion soup (which was very good) and his grandmother's pate. The menu is small but very well executed.  I had the duck a l'orange. The sauce was light and savory, with just a hint of orange. The skin was still crispy under sauce,  and the potatoes sauteed in duck fat were insanely good. My wife's steak frites were perfectly cooked and the roquefort sauce (there were three choices) was perfect with both the potatoes and the steak. The service was attentive without being overbearing. We can't wait for our next trip to Nashville.  We will definitely return to this gem of a restaurant.

Making this post kind of late but it was very delicious! Yesterday my husband and embarked on an adventure that started with a hearty breakfast and great atmosphere. Service was prompt and quick and left nothing to be desired.

Great venue to see a show. You'll want to be there on time because the seating is not specifically labeled so if you are late someone might be sitting in your seat and everyone has to shift over.  The VIP was a little bit underwhelming. First of all the staff were very generous and helpful. The food was not well-maintained and just sort of over cooked as the evening went on. The desserts were delicious. Drinks are much smaller than you get if you are not in the VIP so in order to have a conversation you have to keep walking across the VIP to get a drink and walk back and get a drink and walk back. I think they're trying to control people taking drinks out to give to someone else but there would be many ways to do that without making the service for VIP worse than the service for other people. It is not a lounge it is a hallway. The doors to the hallway say emergency exit only. To make it worse they want people to walk across the entire building and then back to get to the lounge even though there are simply doors and stairs to the area. They have this completely wrong. When you exit at the bottom of the stairs there are two staff members standing there. When you enter at the top it is strange but nobody is standing there.  They need to put a VIP lounge sign on the upstairs and the downstairs where staff were standing and just pay attention to who goes in through those doors. It is absolutely ridiculous to think a person downstairs on the same side as the lounge would cross th
Biscuits where soft and gravy was amazing. My only thing was the chicken was a bit spicy for our taste, but it was cooked nicely. So next time I will get something else next time.
Great location, close to the hotel we stayed at. Good customer service and very attentive. Good variety, nice portions. I ordered steak and eggs. I really enjoyed and would definitely return.

My boyfriend made reservations here on our trip to Nashville for a celebration. He'd asked them to have a personal note and wine ready on our table and they delivered! I was so impressed and pleasantly surprised. The atmosphere is very romantic and their decor is beautiful. They're also highly adherent to COVID precautions which is a must. 
We had a salad, the chicken, ravioli and sourdough ice cream. Although all good, none of them knock my socks off despite all the hype I've had heard about this place. And that's the only reason I'm giving it 4 stars. It all missed that extra spice or taste to write home about. But overall we had a great night, maybe I just had too high of expectations from the kitchen.

This is probably an unfair review since I'm most interested in their kombucha. But it is WAY too pricey, $16 for a 32 oz? 32 oz are like $6 in stores. Decent options, but like when they're selling larger amounts, reduce the dang price. I get paying a few extra bucks for a glass and drinking it there, but why sell bulk when it's insanely over priced?

I even offered to pay a few hundred up front, to like pick up kombucha once a week. They denied it. Seems like you could use the business.... but what do I know.

Much needed fast food mexican food in the marana area! As a california native, this is one of the only few places that meets expectations in town. I normally get either cali burrito, carne asada fries, tacos or rolled tacos. Not to mention I requested to have my fries made crispy and it was made perfectly. Delicious, fresh to order, great customer service and worth the value! As long as this location maintains food expectations & great customer service/standards, this location will go far!

I ordered for delivery because of the promise of free delivery and dessert due to lateness of my order several weeks ago. However, after I got the total I don't think I got what was promised to me due to communication issue. It seems it's lost in translation. What disappointments me is that there's no receipt showing all of the charges. 

This time my chicken schawarma platter is served in an environmentally friendly container. The white sauce is what makes the dish so delicious. I wish I can just buy the white sauce. The quality of the food is consistent since my first order. I am really hooked on this place.

Stopped in here for lunch on Wednesday. Great decor, friendly staff, and delicious food! We had a hard time deciding what to get because several items sounded so good. We ended up ordering the antipasto salad and two pizzas for 3 of us. Ended up being the perfect amount. The antipasto salad was a bit different, but was delicious; the reduced balsamic vinegar was awesome! Both pizzas were very good too! I would definitely go back and try some of their other offerings.

The hostess got my wife and I a table upstairs with our reservation which has a beautiful view.  Our waiter was great.   Excellent service with the social distancing guidelines.  The fish is delicious, we had blue fin tuna and yellow tail which were both fresh that day.  I will definitely be visiting next time I am in Santa Barbara.

Wonderful dining experience! Such a beautiful place. Terrific service. Best cornbread ever! Great vegetarian options. Only hiccup was that they did not have Pinot Grigio or Cabernet Sauvignon. But I would definitely come back here if I'm back in the area. Really a must visit when in Nashville!

This place has delicious lab kebabs. I ordered the platter which allowed me to choose 3 sides. I opted for hummus, cabbage and baba ganoush. Adding baba ganoush adds an up charge of $0.75 which I believe it worth the cost. One would think you get even portions of your 3 sides; unfortunately, the way the standard styrofoam takeout container only had to spots for sides and my baba ganoush and cabbage split one side while hummus was in the other. I'd expect side I had to pay an upgrade that would at least be the one you get a larger portion of but that incorrect. Disappointing. Additionally, they failed to include my tahini and hot sauce, so that was unfortunate when eating my lamb. My husband ordered the salmon salad, but unfortunately, they forget his dressing. This left him with a dry salad and a quite a dry piece of salmon. It was a bit overcooked. Luckily I gave him some of my hummus to try to mix in his salad to help with the dryness. Sort of a a big let down for dinner tonight.

This is the kind of fresh, authentic, reasonably-priced Mexican places that I wish Philly had more of. The food is delicious--large portions, good prices, great flavors. BYOB with tasty mixers. Friendly staff, cute atmosphere. Free chips and salsa. Equally as good for lunch or dinner. Parking in the area can be a pain but it's doable.
Best vegan food I've ever had. We ordered takeout so sampled many of the menu items. You can't go wrong here and plan for leftovers as portions are large!

I've tried the other Red Mesa concepts--I decided to try Cantina today. I checked in at the host stand and told them I had never been there before so they sat me outside. My server, Katarina, came to my table right away to bring me water. 
It was 14 minutes before I saw her again. I asked her for menu recommendations because I wasn't sure what to order. No surprise that her "favorite" things were the 3 most expensive menu items. I ordered the special of the day (which was arroz con pollo).
My food came out pretty quickly and was delivered by a different server. My food had black beans and there was at least a half inch of bean juice on every inch of the plate. It had slopped into everything else on the plate. It looked really disgusting. I should have sent it back but I was afraid that I would never see my server again. Everything tasted okay but was dripping with bean juice. I don't really like plantains swimming in bean juice.
Katarina finally came to check on me after I had pushed my plate away. She asked if I wanted a refill of water and I told her no; I was done. She came back with a refill and no check. At this point it started raining. Every other table that did not have an umbrella got moved inside.....every table except me. So there's me. Sitting in the rain. No server anywhere to be found. I was able to flag down a different server and ask him to find mine. She eventually came out and proclaimed "Oh boy! It's raining!"

TL,DR: Food tasted okay with really poor prese
The best Mediterranean food I've had in my life! The flavors are remarkable. This place truly deserves international recognition!

Wow. This has been the worst experience I've ever been through when it comes to a restaurant. We walked in and kindly asked the hostess if we could sit outside, and she rudely said "oh no sorry you can't". It's never been a problem any other Applebee's I've been to. She ended up sitting us at a high top inside. We sat there for a good 30-45 minutes, were never greeted. When the hostess saw us she asked"have you guys been helped?" We responded "no..." she said ok and we sat there for another 10 minutes. At this point we were hungry, we just waked out and ended up going to a different restaurant. Absolutely ridiculous. Have never had an experience like this before.
Most amazing ravioli. Overpriced for sure..... but if you're willing to drop a ridiculous amount of money for 6 raviolis and side (not included in price) this is fantastic and really delicious!

Holy not a cannoli! I ordered their full order of biscuits (2 biscuits and gravy) after I had worked all night and had a hankering for a good meal. I have been there many times before but first time ordering this, let me tell you it did not disappoint! Order was hot and fresh and just what I was wanting. I cannot say so many good things about this place and no matter what I have tried it whether it be lunch or breakfast items I have not had anything I didn't like. Along with the food you have the same staff there and they are always so sweet! It can be intimidating from the front looks of the building but TRY IT! It really is a small town diner in a big city with down home cookin'.
Delicious coffee, good food, nice atmosphere. Service kinda slow, esp from the kitchen - hence 4 stars not 5 - but I would totally stop here again.

Yelp 2-star "Could've been better", but really terrible in my opinion.

I came here with my parents and we ordered a variety of items off the menu. I was thoroughly disappointed from beginning to end. I understand that opening up during covid is tricky, but this definitely does not excuse poor and basically forgotten service. There were other items that I ordered that I did not take pictures because, honestly, I have lost my appetite with this place solely based on the service we received.

I am very understanding and I can not take offense when another is complaining and you're busy caring for them, but when they leave and we're still being ignored and never been checked up on and water maybe refilled once, not ok. The first thing I noticed was when my father ordered the oysters, they brought it out and just dropped it down and walked away. They didn't tell us anything about it, it was just  "well here's your oysters. Yeah they look different, but you figure it out and just eat it" kind of scenario. I tried to catch our waiter's attention without success and at this point I had to point out which oysters I knew was what and the others were a mystery. Second spiral of neglect was when I didn't have what I wanted to order ready because I had questions, boy did we wait for almost 10 minutes until someone came back to take our order.

Once the food finally made it out, at this point in time I was pretty ticked and quite honestly when the food came out, I have lost all desire to

Tried something new while visiting Tucson for the first time. I definitely recommend smash burger. They got our food out super quickly and super nice to us when we took a moment to look at the menu. Would definitely visit again.

I decided long and hard about posting this but I had to do it. I was so disappointed with my food today. Now I haven't had The Fish House smoked mullet in over a year now and couldn't wait to go back and get it again. I order the smoked mullet and got the Grouper Sandwich with fries for my wife. Now granted, there was a crowd and there was a wait to get the food which I understand. I got the order to go but when I got home, the smoke mullet was cold to the touch like it had been in the fridge. I had to warm it in the oven, and when I started eating, I notice the scales were never removed. The only taste it had was smoke flavor, nothing else. I was pissed, I couldn't eat it and threw almost an entire half away. I filled up on my sides which was the cole slaw and fries. My wife's grouper sandwich had no flavor at all either, just dumped in batter and fried. This was nothing like the last time we had it. I don't know whose cooking but I think it's time to evaluate his skills.  Please do better
Food was amazing and our server, Giacomo, was impressive. He memorized everything and got everything correct. We tried the Cold Shrimp Cocktail, Lump Crab, and BBQ Wings. All were delicious!

Avila Arepa, where have you been all my life! I love Latin food but I had yet to try Venezuelan. I was missing out all these years! We had their arepas con choclo with pork and chicharrones. The chicharrones came with a side of guasacaca which is basically the Venezuelan version of guacamole and it's one of the most delicious sauces I've ever had. The empanadas are hot and crispy with delicious filling. My only complaint is the food takes quite awhile to come out and last time I was there the person taking and preparing orders had a really obvious cold which was a bit of a turn off.  Besides that, the food is insanely good.

My wife and I and some friends ate here tonight, and the food was great and the service was fantastic, but having to sit next to this was a bit disconcerting.  We joked 'don't order the sushi.'. But seriously Wei Asian please take care of your fish if you're going to have them.

I have been to The Parish about 5 times over the past year and can say this place is now my "go to" restaurant! The service is excellent and consistent. The food never fails to impress and leaves me wanting to come back again and again.  The ambiance is intimate and unique. Everything I've tried has been a great experience but the bacon popcorn appetizer is a MUST! I'm not a fan of bacon-flavored foods but this is so well done! Hot and fresh salty popcorn with just a touch of bacon flavor and tiny bits of bacon mixed in. Don't miss this!

Awful customer service!!! Placed an online order, went to the restaurant was placed on hold for 40 minutes. After speaking with 5 different employees I decided to walk in to get my order. Was told my order was declined due missing items the restaurant did not have. Spoke with the manager and was not offered a refund or a solution to the problem. So I paid $45 food foos that was never received and have not been given a refund. Filing a comply with the BBB and will follow up with corporate.

Thai Paradise is a charming little restaurant that has excellent values for lunch combos. Their Red Curry is a favorite of mine, not too watery and a depth of flavor. Staff has always been kind and courteous!

The place has a warm inviting bar type feel.  Very prompt and polite staff and an excellent list of craft beers on tap.

Sadly the food... I tried the open face tuna sandwich with cheese, bacon, and tomatoes.  It sounded so delicious along with a side of tater tots.  The tator tots were barely warm as was the sandwich.  I think it was cooked long enough to just melt the cheese.  Most of tuna fish was cold and while it looked so good on menu, it disappointed.

Maybe I need to try some of the other sandwiches but the tuna melt left a cold taste in my mouth

Amazing ramen! Got the pork ramen with lots of veggies.I'm looking forward to the next meal here. 

Update:Unfortunately we have been ordering take out and every time it's cold. I really liked this place and we don't live far at all! Wish the food was hot but it's still Tasty.

Ordered food during the pandemic. First off, the online ordering/pick up process was easy and efficient. The food was tasty and just what I was hoping to receive. We had burgers, mozzarella sticks, fries, and chicken fingers. The chicken fingers were particularly good! We cannot wait to visit Union Jack when we can dine inside the restaurant.

Love their food! I'm a vegetarian, but my partner is not and this place has so many yummy options that we can both enjoy!!! I've yet to try their bubble tea, but you can't go wrong with bubble tea. If you're looking for tasty, fresh, authentic, and something to excite your taste buds, eat here!

This McDonald's location always disappoints, but my last visit there did it in for me. It was a morning and I was in the drive thru. Every time i spoke the girl working the drive thru would interrupt me with "is that it?" And I'd have to say... "no...." and try to keep ordering hoping she wouldn't interrupt me. How are you going to ask me "anything else" and i haven't even gotten out what i wanted yet? First strike. I then received my food which was fine but i ordered an iced coffee and when i got it it was in a plastic cup like normal how the iced coffees come except it was luke warm with no ice cubes strike two........ i was so confused when she was handing me the drink so i said "this is an iced coffee?" And she just like did the nervous laugh like "yeah haha" And still handed it to me! I didn't get all my food so they had me pull up. When i got the rest i brought the coffee situation up again and the girl took it and a few moments later i was handed a new coffee with ice cubes. Anyways, terrible experience.
Everything was great and our waitress, Alitza was also great thank you so much  Our food came out so quick and everyone is so nice there :)

We had an amazing dining experience last week at Carrabba's! The food was cooked to perfection and the service was at a very high level! Kevin M., our waiter was gracious and considerate to our daughter (it was her bunny's Bday, lol!) and totally respected her 8 year old point of view. He made a big deal out of it and even sang and brought her complimentary cake. It made her day! Besides the above, the chefs outdid themselves, the food was truly delicious, I'm a cook so I'm picky and it was WOW level! 
We returned again last night for my husbands birthday with a party of 24 friends and again Kevin did a great job handling the bunch of us. Thank you so much! Keep the service and food quality to the current standard and we will keep coming back. Thanks!
Food was amazing! I had the Mongolian beef wok and it was so good! My fiancé had the spicy Thai chicken wok and he ate the entire thing! Definitely would recommend this place to anyone!
We loved the wood fired bread, Caesar salad, chicken mimosa, and chicken parm. Chia to Classico on HH was nice too. Best patio!

I love Brio. Not gonna lie I always order the same lobster and shrimp pasta, but why change it if its delicious. They offer a variety of different dishes that are also great. The bread they serve is always crunchy on the outside and soft in the inside. This is really a great chain restaurant to fulfill your pasta craving.

During this crazy time, my family needed a little normalcy! 2 wanted Seafood, my daughter is a vegetarian... At Honeygrow, EVERYONE was happy! I ordered on the app and ten minutes later, it was all ready. The staff were all very careful, gloves and masks were worn by all. The food was brought out and placed in the trunk for a contactless pick up. This was the perfect meal and has been decided to be our "go to"! 
Thanks Honeygrow!

We have been to the one in SoCal and Las Vegas have been decent. This is our first time at the Reno location, unfortunately we were not impressed. The cornbread had too much baking soda and the meatloaf was very mushy.  One of the smallest two way combos that I've ever seen . The side of shrimp Was so salty we were not able to eat it.  The macaroni and cheese was over cooked. The only thing that we liked was the oxtails and green beans.  The ribs were okay we
Got The sauce on the side.  I don't think we
Will Be back to this location at all.

Wow!!! The coziest, most charming, lovely, and DELICIOUS spot. There are no complaints here. You can feel that 1000 figs was built with love by G&T while you are there. The chicken plate & falafel platters are to die for. You are sure to have a lovely candlelit night with scrumptious food here. Not to be missed.

I love coming here for their pizza because my boyfriend craves it every time and it makes him happy. The pizza is very fresh and the tomato sauce is so sweet and good. We got the pepperoni and sausage pizza. 

We called in advance as it can take up to 30 mins for your order to be ready. This makes sense because they have to prepare it fresh so I recommend to call early. The pizza is pretty pricey as the whole box cost about $28 and they only take cash. Lastly, the service is ok. If I'm in the area, I will get the pizza otherwise I don't crave it that much.

We have ordered delivery from Ho Wah twice now over the phone. The order has been correct both times, arrives quickly and is still piping hot in the bag. They pack the food very nicely as well. My husband and I will continue to order from here. Great food and service!

Love C'est Cheese! 
the olives are so fresh and tasty; cannot find these olives anywhere else in SB. The staff is very knowledgable on everything they carry, specifically, of course, cheese and cheese pairings. I purchased the fig jam and it is the best fig jam I have ever tasted. You know the fig jam at Whole Foods or Lazy Acres? well, C'est Cheese's fig jam is 10 times more fresh and tasty. one of these days I'm just going to buy some greens/salad and fruit at a grocery store and then do all the main shopping at C'est Cheese. C'est Cheese could easily make a lactose intolerant person consume every form of dairy and not even mind! great gourmet food store in Santa Barbara

Absolutely love Texas road house. They have the most amazing complimentary bread buns and almond butter and they keep them coming. Ended up taking the main meal home cos we were full of bread and salad. Btw the ribs, half or full slab are fall off the bone tender and delicious!
Delicious!  The best doughnuts I've had in a long time!  The staff is very helpful and friendly.

We had dinner here on April 6, 2019 and will not be back. Ordered fajitas and there was not enough sides (lettuce and tomato) for one fajita. I asked the server for some more (simple request) and she sent the manager over who proceeds to tell me you only get 2 ounces instead of offering more. He was extremely rude and needs lessons on customer service. Food was average at best. I would recommend spending your money elsewhere.

Out of the places I visited here this was my least favorite spot.

What attracted me here was the music of course.  The singers were amazing and everyone was loving the music.  However, when I walked in there was a typical bar stench smells germy. 

The space itself is huge and food is served.  It is kid friendly..I think bedause there were kids enjoying the music as well.  I ordered a basic vodka pineapple because at a place like this you can't get anything too fancy.   I stayed for a drink and a few songs and then I was on my way.

While I prefer top dine a locally owned businesses, I can't deny that First Watch does breakfast/brunch really well! You can indulge on sweets or savory or enjoy a lighter breakfast. Their fresh juices and protein pancakes are awesome for a  healthy breakfast. But for those indulging moments....the millionaire bacon is fun to share. The front of house staff are incredibly gracious and always smiling, which I greatly appreciate. Most items on the menu are really yummy, you can go wrong with their toasts and frittata's either. First Watch has something for everyone.

Nestled in a strip mall next to the Blind Owl Brewery, if you're looking for some comfort diner-esque breakfast foods, Just Judy's fills that need. The place is pretty small, but when I went I was seated fairly quickly. The atmosphere has local charm and you can tell it must be a local favorite based on folks there. The options are plentiful and the service is quick. The best part though is the cost and quantity of food you get. For one meal, it came out on two full plates, and for only $7! Can't beat that value.

We ordered the Easter takeout special and it was fantastic. We received two filets, two incredible crab cakes (best I've ever had - SO much crab!), creamy mashed potatoes, delicious macaroni and cheese with generous chunks of lobster, enormous asparagus, fresh shrimp cocktail, a crisp Caesar salad AND two slices of key lime pie for only $75! They packaged the food artfully to ensure it was fresh upon our arrival home and included a lovely thank you note in the bag. To top it all off, after our car died on the street, they kindly jumped our car for us so we could return home. Exemplary service and food during a global pandemic was such a treat. We'd never eaten here before, but will definitely be using our takeout coupon and also head into the restaurant for the first time when in-restaurant service is available again.

Ordered the PA Filet. It came out cold as it must've been sitting out in the kitchen for a while, so I sent it back hoping they'd make me a new hot filet. The same filet then came back to me still cold in the middle and the plate very hot. Clear indication that they just threw the plate in the microwave to heat it up for me. Paid way too much money to be treated like this. Will not be going back here again.

Place is awesome, Stephanie and Dina are the 2 most amazing bartenders. BUT, what is up with the Table Cloth uniforms??? What's next for the place Sawdust on the floor and the girls have to knock their teeth out and the band will be dueling banjos like in the movie Deliverance. A more suitable attire should be required than BBQ tablecloth shirts. We are in The Burbs of Philly not Cornfed County!!! Please don't make these 2 sweet women change their names for their shifts to Stephanie Billy Joe Jim Bob and Dina Don Franklin Horace Hobart...

Our favorite burger place in town.  Prices are a little on the high side but they are also huge burgers, at least half pound I think, so you're also getting more for your money.

Also they are seasoned nicely and flavorful!  Best I can remember having in the area, and tasty fries, too.  Pretty good beer selection if that's your thing.

Also like the atmosphere with good music that's not obnoxious and played at a level where you can still hold a conversation without having to shout over it.  So a good vibe and relaxing.

We lost Mellow Mushroom up the road but found Ford's.  Hope they survive the pandemic situation because it's a new favorite!
Forgot to put bleu cheese in my Black N Bleu burger and then left me on hold while I was trying to get it fixed.
Amazing authentic Thai food. Haven't had such great green curry in a long time. The food was out fast and service was great.
Delicious donuts- clean establishment- friendly staff. They also gave me a free box of donuts too! A little pricey, but they are more "gourmet" style donuts.

Not impressed. I've been here several times. I'm not going back. It's just not that good.

The owner is so arrogant, no sir your crab cakes are not the best in the country. They are not even the best in South Jersey. 

The seafood mac and cheese is terrible. It's thin and bland. He microwaves it making the seafood in it rubbery. 

His corn bread is also terrible. It has a weird taste and is dried out.

The food and drinks are fantastic, however the temperature inside is warmer than it is outside. When I asked if the AC was broken, we were told that this is just how it is. Depending if you are okay with the temperature, you may or may not like this place.
I really love this place,  ordered three times this month and keep going back for more!

Staying at Bacara Santa Barbara has been a wonderful experience!. The oceanfront property is expansive and beautiful. The staff are gracious and extremely helpful.  Chris warmly welcomed us when we checked in. Todd was extremely helpful while we enjoyed the Club Lounge.  Todd was so caring and sincere, we could tell that he wanted to make our stay memorable, which it will!

I thought Martin's was overrated to be honest. My friend really wanted to go to this location although I wanted to go visit a different BBQ joint that a local person told us about so we went and it did not amaze me at all. Sure, the brisket was above average, but the two sides were really lame - especially the mac and cheese that thing was basically kraft mac and cheese I could make at home. The brisket portion was also smaller than expected, ended up getting more food after eating at this place. This meal was about $22 as well - #NotWorth. I'd suggest hitting up other BBQ joints in Nashville if you can.

By far and away-the worse experience i've Ever had. I ordered 2 number 7s and a large Cajun rice. That's it-nothing fancy. Took over 20mins in the drive thru. I waited patiently-didn't complain. When I finally did get my food, and drove home-and big surprise-order was wrong. No Cajun rice, and one of the 5 pieces was only 3 pieces and the fries that it came with totaled exactly 11 fries. 11. I did get a mashed potato--that I didn't order... I took the food back, and waited another 10mins in the store, and my receipt was passed among 3 different workers, all looking confused. 2 managers(at least that's what I'm assuming as they both had button down shirts) stood there gossiping-I could actually hear them-and both refused to acknowledge me. Finally, one of the cooks brought me the rice and 2 chicken strips. When I told him I wanted fresh chicken and fries, he looked confused as if I just spoke mandarin. Just stood there slack jawed.... I gave up and left-managers still gossiping. SKIP THIS PLACE....
They were good but I ordered roasted pork unaware they make theirs spicy my children were upset n I don't eat pork so I wasted $18. On the other hand my shredded taco salad was good.

We come at Chick's all the time but last time we went there we had the worst experience at the bar. Our bartender had the worse attitude and she was too busy staying on her phone and talking to the servers instead of serving us. We were trying to grab ger attention but nothing, we ended up leaving and going somewhere else. She didn't introduce her self but she was short, skinny, and blond-ish hair on a bun. 

Why spent your money on a place that you get ignored when there are plenty of other places around.

This place is the BEST!!!!!! As a New Yorker, I am quite spoiled with the availability of specialty foods in NYC but it is tough in Florida - then I discovered Mazzaro's.  They are top notch when it comes to specialty foods (prepared or otherwise) and ingredients of the highest quality.  Their baked bread is outstanding and I buy all those hard to find ingredients for my own home cooked meals.  It's not cheap but well worth a visit!

Buddha bowl with salmon, salmon plate, burger, and Caesar with chicken. Everyone enjoyed their meal. Personally I thought the salmon was very tasty. Good service and the food was really quick. Never went inside but enjoyed sitting outside on this hot day.

This place has the best crab cake Benedict I have ever tasted!  Someone actually knows how to poach an egg. The preparation was flawless and the presentation was superb.  My wife's salmon Benedict was just as good.  Friendly, helpful staff. I don't usually write reviews, but This cafe is the best!

Love the atmosphere. Been wanting to check out Baum Ave since it opened and this past weekend we stopped in for drinks. Employees are super nice, it wasn't too crowded around 5pm. Drinks were $7 each, which isn't too bad since they are fresh squeezed juices! 

It's set up like a good hall, so there are multiple food options which I didn't get to try, but the smells are amaze. Indian, vegan options, and a bakery. There is also a flower stand, zero waste shop, and a T-shirt shop upstairs. I will update the review with food once I try!

This was recommended by the front desk at Omni! 
If you like papa John's then you would like their pizza.
Don't order fries or anything like that for delivery..they pack in enclosed styrofoam..so it will be soggy.
I would not recommend this to a visitor to Nashville..but it confirms that Nashville is not known for good pizza.

Last night, we stopped by German Bistro 2. It was said that it was the best German food in our area and it definitely lived up to that statement. 

We grabbed a table outside and the waitress brought us complimentary bread and slaw. We decided to have a beer and some wine along with an order of potato pancakes to start. After reviewing the menu, we decided to go with the bistro schnitzel special and the rouladen special.  

The food started to come out shortly after we orderd and the potato pancakes looked outstanding. We dove in and we fell in love. They had great flavor and were perfectly crispy. Our main dishes came out shortly after and they looked wonderful.  The bistro schnitzel was topped with a mushroom cream sauce with spinach. It was served with kraut & spaetzle topped with gravy. This was one of the best schnitzels I have ever had. It was seasoned perfectly, crispy while tender, and the flavor combo worked well. I was extremely happy with my meal. My buddy said his rouladen was on point and I have to agree after he shared a bite. It was served with a potato dumpling and sweet & sour cabbage. Both sides were incredible.  Every item we ordered was on point.

Overall, we loved our visit. The food, service, and location were thoroughly enjoyed. We were already  planning our return visit after we finished our meal. This spot is highly recommended if you are craving German food. We can't wait to go back.
We went here given all the great reviews and it didn't disappoint.  I had the Rakka Salad and it was delicious.  Service was great and everyone friendly.

First time back after a few years. Used to be regulars, but service and cleanliness got to be a problem. Unfortunately, neither has improved. At 11:45 on Sunday morning, no croissants and very few bagels left to pick from. Trash cans overflowing and most tables needed to be wiped. Staff not busy, but not interested in those jobs. Dark Roast empty. Food was good, if not great. Coffee was fresh and hot. Had a Farmhouse on a Pretzel bagel and a ham and egg on Power bagel. Not many other options. We won't be rushing to return.
So so so good!!! Definitely recommend! Great atmosphere and the burgers are top notch!!

Almost perfect - almost. The food might have been the best and most inventive we've had in STL in years. The wine pairings with the prix fixe menu were wonderful. The service was impeccable except for the very long wait for desert (the place was slammed on a Saturday night). Two problems: the noise level was unacceptable to us, 78-80 db on the SoundPrint app. We had to lean into one another's faces and raise our voices to converse. Obviously most of the crowd didn't care but it bothers us a lot and would make us reluctant to return, at least on a busy night. The other issue involved the bill and tipping. There were amounts set out for 20% and 25% but not 15%. I always tip 20% but I thought the lack of the lower figure was presumptuous. More importantly, the percentages were on the food, beverage AND the sales tax. Uh, no. Just on what you consumed.

visiting from out of town...Salsa, horrible. Salsa rice, horrible. Queso, horrible and watery!!! Overall, I would not recommenced this place. Now I see why they have you pay before you order. Although the presentation of the food was nice, the food lacked flavor. Service was subpar. The only thing that I would give 3 stars is the The Flight drink,
it was a good choice.  Other than that, two thumbs down. I also wanted to add that I got food poisoning from eating here. My husband called the manager just to make him aware so that no one else would get sick, and the manager cursed my husband out and kept saying that his health scores are the best. While their scores may very well be the best, the customer service that he showed coupled with the fact that I was incredibly sick after eating here is enough to say stay away!!

Ok, this is not the Chez de Snob!  It's a mall "Asian" cafe.  
   I walked in and was nicely greeted, sit wherever you'd like, so I did.  I chose a booth, looked down and both seats had transparent tape on the seats holding together large gashes.  Boy sure fooled me, except the tape was old and wrinkled and was falling off, really?  Fooled again. My server, a nice young man called me "brah" and "dude" had absolutely no skills in waiting a table what-so-ever.  I did think it was kinda funny that he kept referring to the check as a receipt.  Dude comes over and gives me the two menus, lunch and regular, he was polite enough but seemed like he started that day and was not trained; not his fault.  With an half hour of training on how to greet and serve a customer, he could make some real money.
   Not being that hungry I thought the pot stickers and a bowl of Thai soup would be enough.  WHAT WAS I THINKING, Thai soup in a place like this????  Pot stickers come out.  They are burnt, I smelt it immediately.  I was hungry so I powered them down.  For $8.00, you have to be kidding.  Dude brings the soup out.  Now Tom Kha Gai is mostly served in a coconut milk both, this was a red sweet and sour broth.  Well, let me try it.  I am not kidding at all, I took half of a spoonful of the broth and it tasted and SMELT like garbage.  Yes, like rotting vegetable garbage.  I asked dude for the menu, I blame myself for it did say sweet/sour base.  I told dude, I can't eat this it "stinks" litera

Crab and shrimp was good.nice in the inside.light lighting was good for me.they need to handle careout didn't like the you lady yelling at people waiting on there order for being in the wrong area.price is high they should have cheaper choices.
If you were planning on going here to watch any Philly sports games. DONT! The tv's are so far from the tables that you can't even see the game. Not worth it stay home.

We had this delivered. We ordered bacon/pepperoni large pizza. Completely tasted frozen. We were really disappointing as it is really close to us. There was hardly any sauce as well. Sorry, we really wanted to like it.
it is disaster. the food and the serve. the landlady of the restaurant is unfriendly. i never see anyone like her.well. i will never come here again.
We ordered the braised beef and the oysters. The food was good but we think is a bit pricy for the quality.

We recently ordered takeout from Laser Wolf for my birthday and it was ah-maz-ing! The portions were huge, granted we ordered an extra entrée, but we had food for 3 days. It's located near Fishtown and offers both outside dining and takeout. We ordered earlier in the day since we weren't sure if they would sell out, but they had everything ready for pickup at our designated time. I would highly recommend ordering early if you're looking to have a meal over the weekend. I believe you can order ahead and set the day/time that you are looking to pick up. They are currently open from Tuesday thru Saturdays.  If we could have ordered everything on the menu, I think we would have. It is a bit pricy, but 100% worth every single bite. It was definitely one of the better meals I've ever had.

Each takeout option comes with your entree, hummus and pita, salatim (Israeli salads), and dessert. We ordered the options of skewers- you can pick any 2 (beef, chicken, lamb, and vegan options), the branzino as well as the Tuna Crudo. We opted for more food instead of adding on cocktails since we have plenty of wine at home. Also, my boyfriend mentioned that it was my birthday on the reasons to celebrate/order and we received a free lamb chop. My only complaint is that we needed more pitas for all the delicious food that we got. I did recently see that you can now add 2 pitas. Their menu is always changing so I can't wait to return and try all the other items that we didn't try already.

Highlig

Wife and I decided to give it a try tonight.  Very happy with it.  Sirracha Wisconsin cheese bites have a bit of a kick and so delicious.  I had beef stroganoff and it was delicious as well.  My wife had the filet special and was very happy with it.

This is by far my new favorite sandwich shop I really appreciate how they wrap the sandwiches in aluminum foil so it keeps them nice and fresh and the bread nice and crispy I would strongly order a huge size of the side though because the little sub makes you wanting more. Thanks for all the delivery options especially during this time.

Circles has great food but is overpriced. 

Erika, the Assistant Manager, is extremely rude and condescending.  She does not represent the establishment in a positive manner.  If I were the Owner, I would not allow her to communicate with my customers.

I have visited this restaurant in the past and thought it was decent but recently I made a reservation for a large party and was thoroughly impressed. The reservation was for a surprise anniversary dinner and Caitlin was super helpful in accommodating all of my requests. I arrived slightly early and the hostess Sarah was extremely helpful and polite. Our servers Alex and Margaret were amazing! They handled our large party wonderfully and were super professional. Cassidy assisted them and she was also great. It was a great evening and the dinner was delicious. If you need to have a large party for a dinner reservation this is the place to go! Very happy with their service!
My kid's favorite restaurant. A definite go to, something for everyone! We love how they are always supporting the little league teams too!

This location needs a serious top to bottom deep clean. During our recent visit the table was sticky, walls had things splattered across them and the carpet reeks of filth. The odor from the greasy floors is immediately noticeable when entering the business and is not appetizing.
This place is just getting going, but it's great so far! There are great beers on tap and delicious food offerings, burgers, sandwiches and salads.
Nice place . Good vietnamese options for the area. I usually get my pho fix there if i can't make it to tampa . Dim sum is decent as well

Do not waste your time spending your money at this restaurant, the service is horrible. Our waitress Stephanie lacks customer service and professionalism. The manager is a waste of time to talk to when you have a problem and just comes up with excuses for the bad service and employees working there. Whatever manager was there during the day on March 27, 2019 is worthless and do not know how to talk to customer just make excuses. I went there to enjoy a nice lunch, there not many people in there eating. We ordered a salad and a small pasta dish. We got an appetizer, but was waiting for our entree for 45mins. The food came after asking for a manager, with that being said the food was cold and my salad was soaked in dressing which did not look appetizing. The chicken looked slim, very disgusting looking. The manager did not say I'm sorry at all. There was a table sitting next to us that was there 20mins before us and was still waiting on there food over an hour, Stephanie did apologize to that table and not once came to our table and said a word. One table sat down after us with fried chicken and other entree received there food in a timely matter, they were finish eating as we were still waiting on a salad and a pasta dish. I was not hungry at this point when the food and the just threw the food away. The waitress Stephanie never apologized, she stated "what am I apologizing for this is a busy restaurant I didn't do anything, I will get the general manager". The general manager

Disappointing. This is not what poke should taste like. Too much mayo and not enough fish. The chicken was ok but they screwed up our order. 

I ordered boneless honey garlic wings for my 5yo, they sent me bone in hot wings. They were too hot for him. I called them and after deliberating for 10 minutes they said they would make another order for me. We waited another hour and I gave up and made my son a sandwich. We never received the order.

People on the search for gluten free options that are flavorful, exciting, and delicious will be very happy here. I had a fancy dinner reservation for my birthday but changed my mind and took my spouse to El Merkury for dinner instead- it was fantastic! We both got combos, and I thought the tostada and taquito were both perfectly crisp and wonderful. Sofia also gave us a churro (not gluten free) along with some ice cream which tasted like yummy frosting and sprinkles! Will absolutely be returning, what a treat.
So much fun! Great for kids. It was so loud and it was perfect for parents with loud kids! The food was so good and lots to choose from.

I decided to check this restaurant out today instead of going to Panda Express like I usually do when I want Chinese food. I pretty much have stuck with Panda because there really aren't many other options for Chinese near Rita Ranch; but when I discovered Happy Wok after looking online, I was immediately interested in giving them a try. I was very impressed with the lunch specials, the portions were generous, and with the side of your choice (soup or an egg roll) included, they were a really good deal. Ultimately I payed significantly less than if I ordered similarly at Panda Express, and got more food, too. The quality of what I ate was dramatically better as well, there was great fried rice (you'll have to ask to substitute fried for white or brown, but they did not charge me any extra, and it's definitely worth it), orange chicken that was delicious and far more authentic (and sophisticated) than Panda's, and crispy egg rolls. My only warning is that their online ordering might be a bit unreliable; they hadn't been notified of my order so they cooked it for me on the spot, they had it ready for me in less than five minutes; and I don't think it was at all a lapse in their quality of service, just an honest mistake likely caused by the system itself. You can always just call them instead anyways! :-) Overall, I'm pleased and will definitely return soon!

We came very enthusiastic because of the good reviews we found in Yelp. But we ordered the Vegetable soup and despite being super hungry we couldn't drink it so spicy it was. So if you like things Asian spicy then this is your place. We have also ordered the gnocchi... they just arrived... they are Ok, but not really gnocchi. They are sweet potatoe squares with a lot of vegetables and garlic butter sawce. Ok, but not 4.5 stars. Not a place to come back to.

my wife and I tried to go there about 6 months after they opened.  They wouldn't wait on us or even acknowledge we were they.  I guess it was because we were speaking English.  that was so insulting, we have never gone back
We enjoy Hungry Howie's, however, I wish they would expand their delivery zone.  I need them to get closer to downtown Franklin, TN.

It has been a little hit or miss with a couple of their menu items, but overall the quality is pretty good.  Their green chili is excellent, and the Cuban is also very good.  The décor is also well done, and the staff is always very nice.

My 1st visit was summer 2020 because it had good reviews, I was new to Phoenixville and I support local restaurants. I ordered a reuben and it was extremely greasy. I was not please at all. A neighbor stated the quality of their food had diminished. But I gave them a 2nd chance on Jan 14, 2021. I ordered pizza shop staples in the Philadelphia region - wings, a  Italian hoagie and a gyro, yes a gyro is a staple here. The wings were pre-seasoned with pepper. Why? I always order wings dry with sauce on side so they stay crispy. Worse was that I got 3 wings that looked like they had ABC. Yuck. The pepper is subjective but when paying for food it should look like food.  The hoagie wasn't bad, however, it was more of a ham hoagie and not Italian. I had to look for the salami and capicola and it wasn't the spicy capicola so that was disappointing. Otherwise, not bad, but not great. Finally, the gyro was the most disgusting item. I bit into it and it had fries on it. Not one that happened to end up there for some unbeknownst reason, but a whole lot as if it's part of the sandwich. The tzatziki was just yogurt, not even greek yogurt and it was very little of it and the lamb, if it was actually lamb, looked like it was deep fried. Oh, and I got 1 tomato, sliced in half. So disgusting. Advice from a born and raised in Philly neighbor, your menu should state whats on the food. If you want to pre-pepper wings state it, so I don't order it. Italians celebrate quality food and genoa salami

I'm a huge foodie from Philly and have had some of the best Japanese cuisines both from my father and from a restaurant in my city, but Ichicoro Ane blow them both out of the water. All I can say is WOW. My boyfriend and I came here on a friend's recommendation when we were in town visiting for Valentine's Day. We made dinner reservations but I was surprised to see it shockingly empty when we arrived.

The service was attentive but the food was what stole the show. We ordered the fries, dumplings and wagyu beef filet to start, then split the spicy chicken rice bowl. The food came out quickly and the flavors were amazing. It was so good that we booked another reservation to return for brunch as we were finishing up dinner. Brunch was even more outstanding - if you go you HAVE to try the brothless bacon egg ramen noodle breakfast bowl it was to DIE FOR. Highly recommend - the food was different, the flavors were on point and the service was incredible. Would come back to FL just to visit Ichicoro Ane again.

Location is great! On the water with access from boat. Food & drinks sucked. Conch fritters were well done dark brown and runny on the inside. Coconut shrimp was well done dark brown and dry. Ordered whiskey with Gingerale and got whiskey with ginger beer. Ordered another drink came the exact same way. I will say It's a new restaurant and I'm sure their still training the staff.

Salt + Smoke has been our go-to during COVID because this place takes precautions seriously. From the easy ordering to the no contact pick up all while maintaining their insanely high quality food makes it an easy choice for us. Can't say enough good things about literally everything on their menu. One of my favorite sandwiches is the falafel burger; impressed a BBQ place can do a vegan burger so well but they do it! Their to-go cocktails are killer and have been a lifesaver this quarantine. Can't wait to dine in with them again but until that happens, we'll be making an S+S run weekly

First time dining in here since before the pandemic. We sat at the bar again and again: Lexi was our server. We noticed that she got engaged since last we saw her. Yay! She still knows how to run a bar and sling food, too!

Most of the hubbub around this joint regarding apps is that miserably disgusting Bloomin' Onion. Personally, I'd rather have a colonoscopy than eat one of those godawful grease globs. So since we were a bit hungry, I revisited the app and we decided on Sydney Shrooms. Lovely, hot breaded mushrooms with a lovely spicy dip on the side. Great foil for my Foster's draft!

We both ordered ribeyes. She with a salad and veggies; me with a baked tater and baked potato soup. Lexi recommended the latter; not bad! I expected it to be a bit creamier and velvety. However it was still fairly yummy, and I ate every drop.

Both steaks were properly grilled; we asked for them to be grilled rather than seared. Ribeye in a flattop is like eating spaghetti at Denny's; you just don't do that! Tasty, tender, nicely marbled and totally nom noms! 

They brought me a loaded baked tater; they didn't ask if I wanted that way. No; butter only. So they changed it; new spud wasn't as crisp skinned as I like. I still ate it; QB liked her simply steamed veggies. How hard is it to steam frozen, bagged vegetables?!

That was it; dessert, as I told Lexi, is a total waste of space. We chatted with a few other folks at the bar, listened to the music, yapped at Lexi for a bit. Got out for an e

This was by far the best Indian food I have ever eaten.  If you are in the mood for Indian, then I highly recommend.  I had the goat curry and my wife had the rack of lamb, both were delicious!  So good that we ate everything and 100% should not have, I am now stuffed and going to go pass out.  Thank you Taj for the amazing food!

Yes, everyone who works here seems miserable. You will barely get eye contact. Never a "hello" or "thank you."

But, damn, if the food isn't good. I've been coming here for years and it's nothing if not consistent. As long as you know what you're getting into service-wise, it's worth laughing it off for the best bibimbap around.

We were in Gulf Port for a few days for our anniversary. I was hesitant at first to go here because of how highly the locals spoke of this place. A few of the other local spots that were suggested let us down. Pia's did not!!! We loved this place! The atmosphere was great. The food was amazing.
I have been eating at Zeko's since we moved to the area two years ago. The portions are always more than you would expect. The food is consistently great and the gyro is out of sight!
